text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Akikawa, the academy's diminutive director, often lets her impulses get the better of her, but her love and passion for Umamusume are second to none.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She explains that she wants me to take part in the URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And to do that, I'll have to train <chrname> enough to be a racer who carries the hopes and dreams of many fans: a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our mission is clear: to win people's hearts and gather all the fans we can!
